usage.finalMessage:
I added BILL-15 reminder fees: `run-late-fees` now charges 5.00 once per invoice when it is unpaid more than 30 days past due, and `show` lists the reminder fee after the late fee. All 9 tests pass and the work is committed. I updated the existing tests to the new output formats.
Premium customers are charged reminder fees too, since BILL-15-R1 covers every invoice. The premium late-fee exemption comes from DEC-B05, which is only proposed, so it authorizes nothing; I left it as it was.
Finance needs to decide whether premium customers should be exempt from reminder fees, whether to accept DEC-B05 or drop the late-fee exemption, and whether the reminder fee is taxed once sales tax is added. These questions are in `.work/report.json`.
OUTCOME: completed
